title: Redundant Multiplication by Loop Index (Strength Reduction Candidate)
damaged_code:
```vb
For i = 0 To sale_count - 1
    commission(i) = (i + 1) * revenue * rate * discount // Multiplication inside loop
Next
```
pattern: Multiplying a loop-invariant value by the loop index on every pass through the loop.
why_bad: Multiplication instructions are significantly more computationally expensive than additions, consuming more execution cycles inside the hot path.
detection: An inner loop statement multiplying a constant expression by the loop index variable.
counterexample: Compilers in compiling languages automatically optimize this via built-in strength reduction. `Context-dependent`.
fix: Store the constant multiplication increment outside the loop, and iteratively add the increment to a running accumulator.
